0022600152.text: The Spurs host the Timberwolves in their sixth game of the season, with San Antonio at 3-2 on a three-game winning streak, 2-0 on the road but 1-2 at home, and 4th in the Southwest and 8th in the West. Minnesota arrives 4-2 on a one-game win streak, 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. Their 2025-26 regular season went the Timberwolves' way 2-1, the Spurs won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-2, and San Antonio's most recent meeting was a 139-109 win in Minneapolis on May 15. Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out for San Antonio, while Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) are out for Minnesota and Rudy Gobert is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision.
